spec.name: Duskwatch Station
spec.description: A stylized arctic research outpost at dusk: an amber-windowed hut on stilts, an elevated boardwalk, a radar tower and a lattice antenna mast, all in flat Firewatch colour.
spec.layout: The model reads as one warm silhouette against implied dusk snow. Rear-left: the main hut, a squat wood cabin on dark stilts with a steep slate-teal roof, amber trim, a glowing window band and a stovepipe; its door faces +Z. From the hut door a raised boardwalk runs straight toward the viewer (+Z) on posts, ending at a landing with a short step, railings, a flag and a few crates and fuel drums. Right of centre stands the instrument tower: an A-frame steel frame about 3.5 m tall carrying a radar dish on a yaw joint, an instrument box, a weather vane and a small red beacon light. A lattice antenna mast with guy wires and a red beacon rises from the hut roof to the model's top. Everything rests on one low snow-and-ice mound that is the only ground; its lowest points touch y = 0. Style on every part: hard flat colour shapes, no gradients, warm wood and amber against cool slate-teal metal and pale snow, with small parts (trim, beacons, flag, glow windows) in their own colours seated on the simple blocky forms; window glass and beacons use the glow kit.

parts.builds: The only ground: one low irregular snow mound built from flat-shaded blocky slabs and a few angled ice ledges, top surface flat at y = 0.45 so everything else sits on it cleanly. Snow top in snow, cliffy cut faces in snowShade, a couple of exposed ice ledges in ice, a shadow drift line along the north side in snowShade. Includes packed-snow patches under where the hut stilts, tower feet and boardwalk posts land, in snowShade, and two or three small snow lumps and a drift lip at the mound edges. Keep it simpler than the buildings: bold flat masses, few pieces.
parts.attaches: Its flat top is mount snowTop; every other part's feet or stilts rest on it. No other part builds the ground.

parts.builds: The hero building: a wood cabin about 2.2 m wide and 1.6 m deep, standing on six dark stilts (woodDark) sunk into the snow so its floor sits at mount hutFloor y = 1.05. Walls in warm wood with visible plank courses as thin plank-coloured strips seated on the surface; corner boards and window frames in roofTrim amber. Front (+Z) face: a teal door (door) with an amber frame and a small round porthole window; beside it a wide horizontal band of two glowing amber windows (windowGlow, glow kit, strength 1.2) with dark ink mullions. Steep gable roof in roof with roofTrim ridge and eave trim, a slight overhang, and a metalDark stovepipe with a small cap poking through the roof. A short skirt of snowShade boards hangs below the floor between the stilts. A woodDark ladder/steps from the snow up to the door threshold at mount hutDoor. A small painted emblem plate (flagCream square with an ink snowflake-ish mark) beside the door.
parts.attaches: Stilts land on snowTop; floor plane is mount hutFloor; door threshold meets mount hutDoor where the boardwalk starts; roof plane at mount roofRidge where the antenna mast roots.

parts.builds: The elevated walkway from the hut door to the front landing: a plank deck (plank tops, woodDark joists and posts) about 0.9 m wide running along z from mount hutDoor to z = 2.4, deck top flush at y = 1.05 matching hutFloor. Two railing sides of woodDark posts with a single amber (roofTrim) top rail and thin metalDark mid rail; a diagonal brace at the landing. The landing widens slightly at the front end with a two-step stair down toward the snow. Props on the deck near the landing: two stacked crates in plank with woodDark banding and a small flagCream stencil mark, two fuel drums in trimTeal with beaconRed band tops, and one short propane cylinder in metal with a beaconRed valve. A flagpole clamped to the landing railing flying a two-stripe flag (flagRed over flagCream) with a tiny flutter built as a flat angled blade.
parts.attaches: Deck meets the hut threshold at mount hutDoor and runs at mount walkDeck height; its posts land on snowTop between the hut and the mound's front edge.

parts.builds: The scientific sentinel: an A-frame tower about 3 m tall on four splayed metalDark legs with cross-bracing (thin metalDark rods), standing on small ice footpads on snowTop around mount towerBase. At mid-height a small instrument shelter box in metal with a teal door face (door) and an amber (roofTrim) trim band. At the top, a yoke in metalDark holding the radar dish: a shallow lathe-built dish in metal with a snowShade back, a short feed horn spike in metalDark at its focus, mounted on the radarYaw joint so it can spin about +Y. Above the dish, a thin whip antenna in metal with a glowing beaconRed tip (glow kit, strength 1.5), plus a small weather vane: an arrow silhouette in metalDark on a beaconRed pivot post. A tiny ladder rung strip climbs one leg. One blinking red marker light on the instrument box roof.
parts.attaches: Footpads rest on snowTop at mount towerBase; the dish rides joint radarYaw (created by the skeleton); nothing else builds the dish or its yoke.

parts.builds: The tall vertical accent rooted on the hut roof at mount roofRidge: a slender lattice mast about 2 m tall made of three thin metalDark corner rods and metal cross braces at three levels, tapering slightly. Top fittings: a small dish (metal, snowShade back) angled toward the sky, two crossbars with tiny insulator beads in flagCream, and a glowing beaconRed ball on the very tip (glow kit, strength 1.5). Three guy wires as thin ink-coloured rods angling down to roof anchor plates in metalDark near the roof edges. A short amber (roofTrim) base collar where the mast meets the roof, and a small snowShade snow cap resting on the dish rim. Nothing else here: it stays slim so the hut stays the hero.
parts.attaches: Roots on the hut roof at mount roofRidge; guy-wire anchors sit on the hut's roof plane built by mainHut; all geometry rides joint site (rigid on the hut's bone region is fine since the model is static apart from radarYaw).

calls.reasoning:
I need to write a spec JSON for an arctic research outpost diorama, Firewatch flat colour style. Multiple builders build parts. I need 3-6 parts, mounts, palette, joints, boxes, budgets.

Let me design: a small arctic research outpost — main cabin on stilts, connected by a boardwalk, radio antenna mast, radar dome, a small sled/snowmobile or propane tanks, snow ground patch? Ground scenery only where the brief names it — "arctic research outpost" implies the outpost itself; I can include a small snow base platform. Keep subject = outpost.

Layout: main hut elevated on stilts (left side), connected via elevated boardwalk/bridge to a smaller instrument tower on the right with radar dish. Antenna mast on hut roof. Prop: fuel drums, propane tank near boardwalk. Firewatch flat colour: bold warm-cool palette, dusky pinks, teal shadows, warm amber windows.

Palette (≤24 colours): snow white, ice blue shadow, dusk pink sky... no, only model colours. Let me pick:

- snowShade: "#cddbe6"
- wood: "#c96f3b" (warm rust-orange hut walls)
- woodDark: "#8a4526"
- roof: "#4a3b5c"? Firewatch uses teal/magenta. roof: "#3e4a5e" (slate teal)

Joints: static model mostly, but maybe a rotating radar dish (hinge), flag. Spec says static models may omit joints; but a radar dome that can rotate is nice. Keep joints: root "ground", radar yaw "radarSpin", flag? Keep simple: joints [] static? The spec template allows either. Rotating radar adds rig interest. I'll include joints: root ground, radarYaw (hinge), doorHinge maybe. Keep 2-3 joints.

Parts (5):
1. snowBase — snow mound platform with boardwalk footings, footprint around everything. box: [[-2.2, 0, -2.6], [2.2, 0.5, 2.6]]. floor: true. budget ~140.

4. instrumentTower — right side: taller A-frame tower with radar dish (radarSpin), instrument box, weather vane, blinking light. box [[0.9, 0.5, -1.4], [2.1, 3.4, 0.8]]. attaches feet to snowBase, deck end mount. budget ~200.
5. antennaMast — on hut roof: lattice mast, guy wires, dishes, red beacon, flag on pole. Hmm, flag maybe part of hut. Could merge antenna into mainHut... but 5 parts evenly. Maybe part 5 = "props and details": sled, barrels, sign? Better keep antennaMast as its own part riding hut roof: box [[-1.6, 2.6, -1.0], [-0.7, 4.6, -0.2]].
